sources.detail: All 6 pages (raid + M+ x DPS/Healer/Tank) fetched live by curl with a browser UA, HTTP 200, 212-371 KB each. Parsed <table class="tier-list">: first <td> = tier letter, each tier-list-entry block's first img alt = "Spec Class" matched WHOLE against the roster. 80 assignments (40 raid + 40 M+), 0 unmatched, each spec exactly once per page. ZERO tier moves. Era-verified per <title>: raid DPS "Midnight (12.0.7)", raid tank "Patch 12.0.7 / Season 1", the other four "Patch 12.0.7 / Midnight"; Devourer Demon Hunter present in both DPS lists — Season 1, no flip. Page-own JSON-LD dateModified: raid healer 2026-08-04T19:56:31+02:00 (yesterday's upstream rebuild, already ingested by the 22:44Z run — hence zero moves today, which is the honest reading of an unchanged page), the other five unchanged at 2026-06-30 / 2026-07-01. NOTE FOR THE OWNER (unchanged, not a data problem): the refresh-tiers skill asks each page to store seasonVerified in sources.json, but the publish job's Gate 0 whitelists only the page `snapshot` key for agent edits, so writing it would fail the night red. Era-verification was performed and is recorded here and in the skill log instead.

All 3 PTR M+ pages (dps/healer/tank) fetched live, HTTP 200, 221-357 KB. Era-verified the OTHER way as the skill requires: every <title> reads "PTR Tier List for Midnight (Patch 12.1 / Season 2)". 40 rated rows applied (27 DPS + 7 healer + 6 tank) on the 7-band icyveins-ptr scale — the DPS list spans S+(2) S(2) A+(9) A(7) B+(4) B(2) C(1). NO TBDs: the string does not appear on any of the three pages, so nothing was written as an explicit null this run. ZERO tier moves. The page's own JSON-LD dateModified reads 2026-08-02 on all three, matching BOTH the value already stored in sources.json and the deterministic pre-agent published-evidence artifact (published-evidence/evidence.json: all three pages resolved 2026-08-02) — so nothing needed re-storing and the published gate has nothing to flag. 3 days old against the 9-day published threshold; upstream rebuilds weekly on Sundays, so this is normal cadence. Era-gated by construction: this source keeps its column and its projection input and never enters the live consensus.

Both pages fetched live by curl, HTTP 200 (165 KB M+ / 153 KB raid). 79 assignments (40 M+ + 39 raid), 0 unmatched roster rows, ZERO tier moves. Parsed by SPLITTING the document on the `<div class="tier__tier` marker (never matching between markers — the documented trap that silently drops each page's last tier) and reading data-original-title on each entry anchor. Vengeance DH remains absent from the raid list — the long-standing upstream omission, left absent rather than invented. M+ bands A(15)/B(19)/C(6), raid S(7)/A(12)/B(10)/C(10). Era-verified: "Midnight" present on both pages, zero "Season 2" occurrences, Devourer present in both lists — Season 1. Method publishes no dateModified, so there is no page-self-date to read. The 8 non-roster M+ labels are dungeon names (Windrunner Spire, Pit of Saron, Magister's Terrace, Maisara Caverns, Seat of the Triumvirate, Nexus Point Xenas, Skyreach, Algeth'ar Academy) and were correctly discarded.

All 6 pages fetched live, HTTP 200, 80-315 KB, using the documented transport: plain curl with a UA alone is 403, curl with the FULL browser header set (UA + Accept + Accept-Language + sec-ch-ua/-mobile/-platform + Sec-Fetch-Dest/Mode/Site/User + Upgrade-Insecure-Requests, --compressed) returns raw HTML; r.jina.ai stays dead for wowhead.com/guide/*. Parsed the embedded WH.markup [tier-list=rows] block (tier-label + spec-badge slugs), which sidesteps the hyphenated "(S-Tier)" prose hazard. TRANSPORT GOTCHA WORTH RECORDING: that block is JSON-ESCAPED in the page source (`[\/tier-list]`, literal `\r\n`), so a regex written against the rendered form matches zero blocks and looks exactly like missing markup — unescape first. 80 assignments (40 raid + 40 M+), 0 unmatched, 0 missing; the M+ DPS A+ band is present (4 specs). ZERO tier moves. Era-verified per title: all six read "Midnight Season 1", Devourer present in both DPS lists. Page-own dateModified spans 2026-04-19 to 2026-06-25 per page, unchanged since the last run — these lists have not been rebuilt in weeks, so zero moves is upstream cadence, not a stalled fetch.

All 6 aggregate pages re-parsed from the __NEXT_DATA__ script tag in raw HTML (specTierListSection.tierLists): raid = the THROUGHPUT tierList, M+ = the SCORE tierList, never the default popularity grouping. 80 rows (27 DPS + 7 healer + 6 tank per bracket), 0 unmatched icons. ONE TIER MOVE, the only rating change anywhere this run: raid throughput Devourer Demon Hunter S -> A. It is upstream drift rather than a parse artifact — Augmentation Evoker (184.7k) is now the sole S entry, Devourer sits at 180.5k in A, and Archon's own numbers moved with it (Devourer 95th-pct DPS 180,424 -> 180,495, parses 27,351 -> 25,185; see archon-metrics). One single-band move is far inside the anomaly limits. IMPORTANT CONTEXT: Archon's lastUpdated still reads 2026-08-04T12:00:00Z at 12:31Z today — a cache-busted re-fetch returns the same label, so this is not a CDN stale copy; their daily aggregate had not republished at fetch time while the underlying rolling window kept moving. Era-verified from the page's own encounter list: the raid pool is Imperator / Vorasius / Salhadaar / Vaelgor & Ezzorak / Vanguard / Crown / Chimaerus / Belo'ren / Midnight Falls (the Season 1 raid, 373,222 parses) and the M+ pool is the Season 1 dungeon set — NOT the Season 2 PTR pool, so no season flip.

Full re-fetch of all 9 Venomous-era raid bosses (throughput) + 8 M+ dungeons (score) x 3 roles = 51 pages, every one HTTP 200 with a parseable __NEXT_DATA__ blob and every encounter yielding all 40 specs. 680 tier rows re-derived (floor 440). 23 of 680 moved this run, all single-band and spread across 8 encounters — e.g. Imperator: Devastation Evoker A->B with Fury Warrior / Destruction Warlock / Assassination Rogue / BM Hunter C->B; Vorasius: Subtlety Rogue A->S, BM+MM Hunter and Resto Druid B->A; Chimaerus: Prot Warrior and Guardian Druid S->A, Prot Paladin A->B, Brewmaster B->C. Consistent with the same rolling-window drift the aggregate pages show. Encounter display names are preserved from the stored file rather than taken from the per-encounter page's encounterOptions label — that label is truncated ("Imperator" vs the stored "Imperator Averzian", "Salhadaar" vs "Fallen-King Salhadaar"), and adopting it would have silently renamed two bosses.

The survivability tierList re-parsed from the same three raid aggregate pages: 27 DPS + 7 healer + 6 tank = 40 rows, 0 unmatched, merged via apply-metrics.mjs survivability key, asOf 2026-08-05. ZERO tier changes vs stored. Survivability is display-only (drawer Source ratings box) — it feeds no consensus and no projection.

Re-read from __NEXT_DATA__ specRankingsSection.table.data[] (NOT tierList): "95th pct DPS (Mythic)" = 33 rows, value = the dps column rounded to the stored integer convention, n = parses. Kept to the stored convention of DPS + tank specs only — the raid healer page also exposes a dps column and ingesting it would silently widen the series to 40; healers publish under the HPS name instead. Values DID move (e.g. Frost Mage 176,153 -> 176,158, Retribution 170,106 -> 170,261, Augmentation 184,315 -> 184,735) and so did the parse counts, several of them DOWNWARD (Devourer 27,351 -> 25,185, Augmentation 19,154 -> 17,603), which is the signature of a rolling window shedding old parses rather than a fresh daily cut. Recorded as success on that evidence even though Archon's own lastUpdated label still reads 2026-08-04T12:00:00Z (cache-busted re-fetch confirms the label, not a stale CDN copy) — same disposition the 2026-08-04 12:31Z run took when values moved under an 08-03 label.

"95th pct HPS (Mythic)" re-read from the raid healer page's specRankingsSection hps column = 7/7 healer specs with n = parses, asOf 2026-08-05. Values moved with the rest of the Archon surface (same rolling-window drift described in archon-metrics); no healer moved by more than a fraction of a percent.

"M+ score (95th pct)" re-read from the three M+ pages' specRankingsSection score column = 40/40 specs with n = parses, asOf 2026-08-05. The M+ aggregate is integer-valued and coarse, so most rows reproduce exactly; the ones that moved moved by single points.

80 rows (40 raid + 40 M+) parsed from specRankingsSection.table.data[].popularity as fraction x 100, rounded to the stored 1-decimal convention, asOf 2026-08-05. A handful moved by 0.1 (Unholy DK 9.8 -> 9.7, Devourer 7.5 -> 7.4, Elemental 5.2 -> 5.3) — same daily surface as archon-metrics/-hps/-mplus-score.

THE FROZEN snapshotDate HAS UNSTUCK — the escalation the last two runs raised for a human is resolved and needs no decision. Fetched via the JSON API only, never the stale HTML prerender: data.wowmeta.com/manifest.json + /rankings/midnight/mplus/all/0.json, both HTTP 200 on plain curl. manifest.json now reads snapshotDate 2026-08-05 with completedAt 2026-08-05T03:22:11.985Z (it had been pinned at 2026-07-28 for eight days while the rankings object kept being re-published), so their manifest pipeline is running again and the maxAgeDays 8 breach that would have fired on 2026-08-06 will not. 44 blocks; whitelisted categoryType in {dps,hps,tank} + sortField "lowerBound" + keyRange undefined = 3 blocks / 27+7+6 = 40 rows, 0 unmatched. At the stored 2-decimal precision ZERO values moved — correct and expected: the 08-04 run had already ingested exactly these numbers when the rankings object was re-published that evening, and only the source's own stamp has now caught up. asOf is the source's snapshotDate as the recipe requires, not today's fetch date; they happen to coincide.

This agent holds NO Warcraft Logs credentials and fetched nothing from warcraftlogs.com by any means. Its only WCL input is wcl-fetch/evidence.json, written by the deterministic pre-agent step at 2026-08-05T12:25:27.834Z: verdict "rdps-broken" — characterRankings(metric: rdps) on encounter 3176 returned HTTP 200 with a bare "Internal server error" and 0 rankings, so the whole redistributed-credit metric family is still broken upstream. OAuth and GraphQL transport both report ok (rate limit 3600/h, 1 point spent), which isolates the fault to the rdps metric family exactly as documented in the refresh-metrics skill. evidence.landed carries no entry for this key, so the zone-46 Mythic medians could not honestly land and the 47 stored rows were LEFT UNTOUCHED at 2026-08-04 (1 day old against maxAgeDays 10 — they were refreshed by a residential-IP local run, which can reach the HTML statistics endpoint that CI cannot).

Same cause as wcl-live-raid: no credentials held by this agent, no warcraftlogs.com fetch attempted, and wcl-fetch/evidence.json (verdict "rdps-broken", attempted 2026-08-05T12:25:27.834Z) lists no landed rows for this key. The 40 zone-47 M+ median rows were left unchanged at 2026-08-04, 1 day old against maxAgeDays 10.

Zone-54 normalized "12.1 PTR raid testing score" — unreachable for the same reason (no credentials, evidence verdict "rdps-broken", no landed rows for this key). Independently of the outage this series is also empty upstream: zone 54's 14-day rolling window has aged out the mid-July testing parses, which is why the 34 stored rows have stood at 2026-07-28 and the zone-54 registry page snapshot was deliberately left there rather than papered over. 8 days old against maxAgeDays 10 — it breaches on 2026-08-08 unless a new Blizzard testing window lands first; the Venomous Abyss opens 19 August per this run's blue-tracker sweep. (The evidence file's separate raw-DPS recipe for the same zone DID land — see wcl-ptr-raid-raw; different transport, different statistic.)

Zone-56 "Mythic+ Season 2 (PTR)" rDPS/HPS medians — no credentials held, no warcraftlogs.com fetch attempted, and evidence.landed has no entry for this key under the "rdps-broken" verdict. The 40 stored rows were left unchanged at 2026-08-04. Note the contrast with wcl-ptr-mplus-raw below, which DID land: the raw series uses metric "dps" through the v2 API, the frozen series needs "rdps", and the two are never substituted for one another.

spec.ptrDummy (zone 52 median rDPS by target count) — same outage, same evidence file, no landed entry for this key. The rDPS-family break is exactly what blocks this series while its raw-DPS counterpart lands. 27 stored specs left untouched at 2026-08-04.

40/40 rows (27 DPS + 7 healer + 6 tank) by plain GET on the three /meta/<role>/m+ pages, HTTP 200, 41-72 KB (r.jina.ai does not work on murlok). Split on `<a [^>]*meta-item` — never `<a class=` — because murlok emits both attribute orders and the narrower splitter silently returns 35 of 40 rows while reporting 0 unmatched. Within each card the SECOND .h3 is the "Spec Class" label (the first is the rank number) and the rating is the number after </svg> in the infobar <li>. THE PERIOD ROLLED, BUT THE NEW ONE IS NOT LIVE YET: /period/latest now 302s to /period/1075, and /period/1075 itself 404s (7.5 KB error body) — the new week exists in the /period index but has no page. That is a genuine upstream absence, so their stored rows keep their older asOf rather than being invented; 36 rows clears the floor of 25 and the 39 -> 36 drop is 7.7%, inside maxRowDropPct 0.25. Alt labels are HYPHENATED per class — normalise hyphens to spaces before roster matching or 7 rows silently drop.

The 9 specs still at ptr: null (Frost DK, Feral/Guardian/Restoration Druid, Holy Priest, Elemental Shaman, all three Warlocks) stay that way: swept the news index 6 pages / 120 unique posts back to 2026-07-15 via data.news.newsData and the newest 12.1 spec review in that window is still Restoration Shaman (news=382300, 07-29), already covered. No writeup was manufactured from tuning lines or from the new Frost DK creator take. NO SEASON FLIP: every live source still self-identifies 12.0.7 / Season 1. Blue-tracker headlines this run date the patch 11 August and BOTH Season 2 and the Venomous Abyss raid 19 August (one day later than the Aug-18 date carried in earlier notes). STANDING OWNER ACTIONS, two different events: node src/snapshot.mjs --frozen on the LAST pre-launch refresh, then the SNAPSHOT_PHASE flip in render.mjs at launch; PHASE_FLIP_DUE 2026-08-20 still leaves margin against a 19-August season start.
